summary: PR-176 can be implemented fail-closed only if its spec freezes two distinct estimand signatures, treats PR-148 covariance as an explicitly forbidden fsigma8-only source, authenticates a new div-v/q covariance by semantic identity rather than by path or PSD alone, recursively excludes raw reconstruction payloads, and recomputes every informative or NON_INFORMATIVE terminal from frozen primitives. A passing harness is process evidence only; it cannot promote a physical, global-tilt, monopole-immunity, or family claim.

finding.statement: A prospective spec, independent source-rebinding contract, total terminal truth table, mutation battery, deterministic writer/checker, and targeted regression suite are sufficiently specified for the main writer to implement PR-176 without reusing an unrelated covariance or leaking raw reconstruction fields.
finding.scope: harness design only; no production implementation or scientific result
assumptions: The exact production API and on-disk PR-176 schemas do not yet exist and must be frozen before any observed output is inspected.
Only the registered assignment inputs were inspected; no sibling result and no unregistered PR-176 production surface was read.

A valid PR-176 joint covariance, if one becomes available, must be generated from matched replicates of the exact registered div-v and q-dipole estimands. Positive definiteness or dimensional agreement alone is never sufficient authority.
Before PR-155, any informative terminal remains a conservative-dependence channel falsifier only. NON_INFORMATIVE is a successful terminal scientific route when the registered information gates fail.

evidence_read.supports: PR-176 dependency, estimand-separation, conservative-dependence, near-rigid-translation, NON_INFORMATIVE, raw-column semantics, and test contracts
PR-148 covariance is the same-data covariance of per-shell fsigma8, not a div-v/q covariance
Exact forbidden-upstream covariance identity and source hashes
Vpds, Vpwf, and Vpec are estimator-dependent reconstructions and cannot be emitted or treated as true flow
Existing deterministic write/check, live mutations, manifest, and covariance behavior
Orthogonal availability, lineage, numerical-status, and null-terminal discipline
Independent frozen-source reconstruction, coordinated-reseal mutations, content receipt, and byte-reproducible checker pattern

identity_and_scope: schema, spec_version, pr_id, title, frozen_before_result=true, full baseline_commit
allowed_use limited to structural div-v versus q-dipole channel falsification under a frozen conservative dependence contract
forbidden_use includes physical attribution, global tilt, monopole-leakage immunity, covariance identification by proxy, native-transfer validation, and family identification
dependency_authority: Exact successful status receipts and hashes for PR-133, PR-144, PR-146, PR-148, PR-167, and PR-173
PR-173 spec and runner hashes as finite-ensemble and terminal-routing authorities
No mutable live status or candidate-generated hash may substitute for a frozen dependency receipt

estimand_registry.distinctness_gate: The canonical estimand digests must differ, theta_div_v must be scalar divergence rather than a second bulk-flow dipole, and q_dipole must not be reconstructed by substituting the bulk-flow beta closure for the measured divergence.
estimand_registry.overloaded_symbol_policy: Freeze theta, H, beta, lambda_H, d, q, sign conventions, dimensions, and any mapping to Delta_q explicitly before result access.

analysis_freeze: Freeze lambda or scale, spatial/depth bins, axis or axis-selection rule, mask/support, frame, transfer declaration, injection amplitudes/seeds, tolerances, and falsifier threshold before reading coherence outputs.
Changing lambda, axis, support, frame, transfer, or threshold creates a new analysis identity and invalidates old output bytes.
Freeze a near-rigid-translation diagnostic and absolute plus relative tolerances in declared units; the tolerance may not be inferred from the observed theta value.
channel_injection_contract: Rigid translation fixture: the divergence response must be within the frozen zero tolerance while the bulk-flow-like control may respond.
Isotropic expansion or compression fixture: theta_div_v must respond with the preregistered sign and normalization; a symmetric bulk-flow control must not be silently substituted.
q-dipole channel fixture: the q channel must respond under its own operator, with cross-response recorded rather than assumed absent.
Radial-monopole and mask/leakage fixtures: channel cross-response must be measured and reported; passing does not imply immunity.
Axis rotation, sign reversal, and unit/frame mismatch negative controls must be frozen with exact tolerances.
Every fixture records input digest, generator digest, seed, expected response, tolerance, observed response, and pass/fail.

explicitly_forbidden_sources: Any covariance whose estimand signature is the PR-148 per-shell fsigma8 vector
joint_covariance_contract.semantic_rejection_rule: Reject a covariance unless every identity field is independently reconstructed from the frozen PR-176 spec and matched replicate receipt. Reject PR-148 even if copied, renamed, reshaped, made PSD, or accompanied by newly resealed config/input hashes.
joint_covariance_contract.missing_or_invalid_route: Never impute a diagonal, reuse an upstream covariance, or choose rho=0 or +/-1. Route to a typed NON_INFORMATIVE outcome.

conservative_dependence_contract: Freeze the dependence uncertainty set before outputs; absent stronger authenticated constraints it must include the full Cauchy-Schwarz-compatible cross-covariance range.
Evaluate the entire registered dependence set and report the worst-case bound. Selecting a favorable endpoint after observing the result is forbidden.
An informative pre-PR-155 output is only CONSERVATIVE_DEPENDENCE_BOUND_CHANNEL_FALSIFIER. It is not a joint fit, detection, or physical attribution.
If the worst-case interval overlaps the frozen falsifier boundary, route to NON_INFORMATIVE_CONSERVATIVE_BOUND_OVERLAP.

raw_reconstruction_firewall.upstream_semantics: PR-144 classifies Vpds, Vpwf, and Vpec as estimator-dependent reconstructions, never true flow.
raw_reconstruction_firewall.input_policy: Any unavoidable read-only reconstruction input must enter only through a typed PR-144-pinned adapter with semantic_role=estimator_dependent_reconstruction. Implicit column-name fallback is forbidden.
raw_reconstruction_firewall.output_policy: Scientific outputs contain only aggregate estimands, matrices, counts, hashes, diagnostics, and synthetic-fixture receipts. They contain no row-level catalogue, velocity sample, object identifier, coordinate, or reconstruction array.
raw_reconstruction_firewall.recursive_key_normalization: Lowercase and remove punctuation/underscores before comparison; reject normalized keys or declared column names vpds, vpwf, and vpec at every nested path outside the spec's policy declaration.
raw_reconstruction_firewall.semantic_value_rejection: Reject any produced value or caption that labels a reconstruction as true_flow, observed_velocity, measured_true_velocity, or equivalent forbidden wording.
raw_reconstruction_firewall.schema_allowlist: Validate complete output schemas so a raw array cannot be hidden under an unrecognized key even when the key does not contain a forbidden column name.

prospective_spec_fields.terminal_contract: Use the total truth table below; scientific terminal and process execution status are separate fields.
prospective_spec_fields.artifact_contract: Declare exact output paths, canonical JSON serialization, source/config/input hashes, worktree receipt, allowed and forbidden uses, and fresh-build-equals-disk check policy.
prospective_spec_fields.mutation_contract: Freeze exact mutation IDs before result access; every mutation must execute through the production validator and be killed. Literal-only scans do not count.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: The complete estimand, frame, transfer, support, lambda/axis, injection, dependence, terminal, and mutation contract is hash-frozen before observed output.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: Any output exists before the spec freeze or a result-dependent parameter changes without a new analysis identity.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: All six requires_success dependencies are independently rebound to exact frozen receipts and hashes.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: A dependency is missing, non-successful, mutable-only, stale, or self-declared by the candidate output.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: theta_div_v and q_dipole have distinct canonical estimand digests and pass the frozen translation/expansion/q-channel fixtures.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: The divergence is discarded, replaced by beta, represented as a second dipole, or conflated with the radial-monopole estimator.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: All output schemas pass recursive raw-field and semantic-label validation and contain aggregate-only data.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: Any nested raw reconstruction field, row-level payload, implicit reconstruction fallback, or true-flow wording appears.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: A 2x2 covariance is bound to matched replicates of the exact ordered div-v/q estimands with units, frame, support, lineage, cross term, finite symmetry, and PSD diagnostics.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: The covariance is PR-148-derived, diagonal-assumed, cross-term-free, label-swapped, source-resealed, support-mismatched, non-finite, non-PSD, or missing lineage.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: The full preregistered dependence set is evaluated and the worst-case bound governs the result.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: A favorable correlation endpoint is selected, an unidentified covariance is promoted, or a point estimate replaces the bound.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: Fresh primitive reconstruction selects exactly one registered scientific terminal, including NON_INFORMATIVE branches, while process status remains separately typed.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: A candidate terminal is trusted, a near-rigid or covariance-invalid lane becomes informative, or NON_INFORMATIVE is mislabeled a process failure.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: Canonical fresh build matches every on-disk byte; manifest, source receipts, and worktree receipt independently rebind all changed surfaces.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: A stale byte, missing artifact, candidate-controlled hash, omitted local source, NaN/Inf, nondeterministic ordering, or manifest mismatch survives.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: The exact frozen mutation keyset has registered_count=executed_count=killed_count and zero survivors.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: Any mutation is skipped, literal-only, replaced after results, or survives coordinated resealing.

proposed_gates.pass_condition: Outputs remain internal C3 conservative channel falsification or NON_INFORMATIVE and explicitly deny immunity and physical attribution.
proposed_gates.fail_condition: Any output claims detection, global tilt, monopole immunity, true flow, native validation, geometry, or family identification.

terminal_truth_table.condition: Any spec, dependency authority, estimand identity, raw-field, deterministic-pack, or mutation gate fails
Joint covariance exists but fails semantic identity, matched-lineage, finite, symmetry, PSD, support, frame, transfer, or cross-term gates
Any frozen channel injection or finite-ensemble certifiability gate fails
Worst-case conservative dependence interval touches or crosses the frozen falsifier boundary
All gates pass and the complete worst-case conservative dependence interval lies on the preregistered falsifier side
terminal_truth_table.claim_ceiling: structural channel falsifier only; no immunity, attribution, detection, or global-tilt claim

requirements: Mutually exclusive required modes; --check performs no writes.
Build authoritative expected payloads from the frozen on-disk spec and source manifests, never from candidate manifest claims.
Serialize JSON with sorted keys, UTF-8, allow_nan=false, explicit newline, and a frozen numeric canonicalization policy. Do not silently round gate-driving primitives.
On --write, render every payload in memory first, validate the complete pack, then atomically replace changed files with mode 0644; never publish a partial generation.
On --check, compare fresh rendered bytes to every expected artifact and report all missing or stale paths with exit code 2.
Generate the manifest last from freshly rendered artifact bytes and exclude the manifest from its own artifact map.
Recompute the result terminal from primitive reports after build; do not trust a result-card terminal or semantic digest.
Run every registered mutation through the same public validator and independently reconstructed authorities.
Reject unknown output keys, unexpected artifacts, non-finite values, duplicate channel IDs, and unordered covariance labels.

source_rebinding.config_hash: Actual SHA-256 of the frozen PR-176 spec bytes.
source_rebinding.upstream_receipts: Actual bytes of each frozen upstream manifest must match the spec pin; each small declared artifact is hashed and compared to its upstream declaration. Raw catalogue bytes are not repeatedly hashed.
source_rebinding.local_input_hashes: Actual SHA-256 values for the scientific module, runner, focused test, spec, and any adapter or semantic guard consumed by the build.
source_rebinding.source_receipt_root: Domain-separated SHA-256 of canonical sorted path, semantic-role, and hash tuples reconstructed independently of outputs.
source_rebinding.worktree_content_receipt: Domain-separated SHA-256 of canonical sorted hashes for every PR-176 changed production/spec/test/runner surface plus the full baseline commit. Generated outputs are bound separately by the manifest.
source_rebinding.anti_reseal: The validator compares candidate metadata and terminal to a fresh expected mapping. Recomputing a candidate semantic digest or replacing all candidate hash strings cannot change the expected authority.

aggregate channel estimands and conservative bound only

channel-wise synthetic injection and cross-response evidence

artifact hashes, owners, scope, claim ceiling, source/config/input/worktree receipts, support/mask/covariance/null status, commands, caveats, Git state

commands, pass/fail counts, skipped dependencies, terminal, claim boundary, and residual risks

mutation_registry.defect: Use docs/generated/pr148_joint_covariance.json as the div-v/q covariance.
mutation_registry.kill: Forbidden-source and estimand-signature gates reject it.

mutation_registry.defect: Copy or reshape PR-148 covariance, rename the file/schema, and reseal candidate hashes.
mutation_registry.kill: Fresh semantic reconstruction rejects wrong ordered estimands, matched lineage, units, support, and cross-term provenance.

mutation_registry.defect: Set the cross term to zero or omit it.
mutation_registry.kill: Matched-replicate cross-term receipt is mandatory; diagonal assumption is not evidence.

mutation_registry.defect: Select rho=0, +1, or -1 after seeing the result.
mutation_registry.kill: Full frozen dependence-set replay differs from the candidate bound.

mutation_registry.defect: Swap theta_div_v and q_dipole labels or matrix order.
mutation_registry.kill: Ordered estimand digests and matrix identity mismatch.

mutation_registry.defect: Rescale a channel, change frame, transfer, mask, sky support, or shell while retaining covariance bytes.
mutation_registry.kill: Independent unit/frame/transfer/support digests mismatch.

mutation_registry.defect: Use unmatched replicate IDs, omit seed/batch lineage, or claim a cross term from separate ensembles.
mutation_registry.kill: Matched replicate root and source receipt mismatch.

mutation_registry.defect: Inject NaN, Inf, asymmetry, negative eigenvalue, or invalid condition diagnostics.
mutation_registry.kill: Canonical serializer and numeric covariance validation reject it.

mutation_registry.defect: Add a top-level Vpds, Vpwf, or Vpec payload.
mutation_registry.kill: Recursive normalized-key and schema-allowlist firewall rejects it.

mutation_registry.defect: Hide a reconstruction array under nested case, punctuation, alias, unknown key, or column-name metadata.
mutation_registry.kill: Path-independent normalization plus complete schema allowlist rejects it.

mutation_registry.defect: Relabel an upstream reconstruction as observed or true flow.
mutation_registry.kill: Semantic value and forbidden-language validation rejects it.

mutation_registry.defect: Replace theta_div_v with beta, a bulk-flow dipole, or a second q-dipole measurement.
mutation_registry.kill: Canonical estimand digest and rigid-translation/isotropic-expansion fixtures fail.

mutation_registry.defect: Emit an informative result when the near-rigid-translation guard triggers.
mutation_registry.kill: Fresh total routing requires NON_INFORMATIVE_NEAR_RIGID_TRANSLATION.

mutation_registry.defect: Emit an informative result with covariance unavailable.
mutation_registry.kill: Fresh total routing requires NON_INFORMATIVE_JOINT_COVARIANCE_UNAVAILABLE.

mutation_registry.defect: Emit an informative result with a covariance identity or lineage failure.
mutation_registry.kill: Fresh total routing requires NON_INFORMATIVE_JOINT_COVARIANCE_INVALID.

mutation_registry.defect: Promote a bound touching or crossing the falsifier threshold.
mutation_registry.kill: Strict full-interval routing returns NON_INFORMATIVE_CONSERVATIVE_BOUND_OVERLAP.

mutation_registry.defect: Change lambda, axis, support, or threshold after output while resealing the result.
mutation_registry.kill: Frozen config hash, analysis identity, and independently rebuilt targets mismatch.

mutation_registry.defect: Change candidate config_hash and semantic digest together.
mutation_registry.kill: On-disk spec hash is independently recomputed.

mutation_registry.defect: Change a local or upstream input hash and reseal all candidate receipts.
mutation_registry.kill: Fresh byte hashes and upstream manifest declarations are independently reconstructed.

mutation_registry.defect: Modify or omit one changed production/test/runner surface while preserving the old receipt.
mutation_registry.kill: Canonical changed-surface path/hash inventory mismatches.

mutation_registry.defect: Edit result-card terminal, process status, success_dependency_satisfied, and digest consistently.
mutation_registry.kill: Terminal is recomputed from frozen primitive reports.

mutation_registry.defect: Add monopole immunity, detection, global tilt, true flow, native validation, geometry, or family language.
mutation_registry.kill: Claim classifier and exact forbidden-language rules reject it.

mutation_registry.defect: Change one artifact byte without updating the authoritative fresh build.
mutation_registry.kill: --check reports the exact stale path and exits 2.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: PR-148 fsigma8 covariance is reused, relabeled, or resealed as a div-v/q covariance.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Semantic estimand, matched-lineage, unit/frame/support, cross-term, and explicit forbidden-source validation; direct and coordinated-reseal mutations.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: An informative result is emitted with missing or invalid joint covariance, a near-rigid translation, or a bound overlapping the falsifier threshold.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Fresh total terminal reconstruction with NON_INFORMATIVE precedence and coordinated terminal-reseal mutations.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: theta_div_v is silently replaced by the current beta closure or reduced to a second dipole measurement.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Distinct estimand digests plus rigid-translation and isotropic-expansion fixtures.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: Raw reconstruction rows or Vpds/Vpwf/Vpec arrays leak into artifacts or are called observed/true flow.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Complete output-schema allowlist, recursive normalized-key scan, aggregate-only cardinality contract, semantic label scan, and nested-alias mutations.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: Lambda, axis, support, frame, transfer, tolerance, or threshold is tuned after observing coherence.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Pre-result config freeze; any drift creates a new analysis identity and invalidates byte checks.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: Candidate-controlled manifests, semantic digests, or status fields form a self-oracle false green.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Independent frozen-source reconstruction, worktree content root, and coordinated reseal mutations.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: Structural distinctness is promoted to immunity from radial-monopole or other shared leakage.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Cross-response injections, explicit not-immune caveat, claim classifier, and forbidden-claim mutation.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: Nondeterministic float formatting, NaN, output order, or partial writes make the pack irreproducible.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Canonical allow_nan=false serialization, in-memory full-pack validation, atomic publication, and one-byte stale test.

severity_ranked_harness_risks.risk: A scientifically NON_INFORMATIVE result is mistaken for harness failure or is omitted from status bookkeeping.
severity_ranked_harness_risks.kill_switch: Separate process_execution_status, scientific_result, and success_dependency_satisfied fields with truth-table tests.

remaining_main_writer_decisions: Freeze the exact mathematical q-dipole operator and its dimensional normalization after inspecting the registered production surfaces; this assignment does not authorize inventing it.
Choose the existing package-consistent module path if it differs from the proposed htt/obsstat path, then bind that exact path in the worktree receipt.
Freeze the actual matched-replicate covariance source or explicitly accept the unavailable NON_INFORMATIVE route. Do not manufacture it from PR-148.
Freeze numerical injection and near-rigid tolerances prospectively using independent fixtures, not the observed PR-176 result.
